message: Function DATEADD() wraps a column reference in a predicate. This prevents index usage (non-sargable). Consider rewriting to apply the function to the comparison value instead.
alternative_solution: Invert predicates so functions operate on constants/literals rather than column references (SARGable rewrite). For example, transform YEAR(order_date) = 2024 into date range order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01'. For case-insensitivity, utilize case-insensitive collations (e.g. COLLATE NOCASE) or functional indexes.
